sources.entry: Snagit - Simple, Powerful Screen Capture Software and Screen Recorder.

summary.name: Snagit
summary.one_liner: Snagit is TechSmith's screen capture and recording application for Windows and macOS, used to make annotated screenshots, screen recordings, and step-by-step visual guides.
use_cases: Capture long web pages or spreadsheets in one scrolling screenshot
Create step-by-step process guides and tutorials
Annotate screenshots with arrows, callouts and text
Record quick screen videos with voiceover for walkthroughs
Redact sensitive information before sharing screenshots
Build onboarding and knowledge base documentation
summary.what_it_does: Snagit captures screenshots, including entire scrolling pages, documents and spreadsheets in a single capture. It lets users add arrows, callouts, text and markup to captures, and apply team themes for colors and fonts. It records screen video with microphone, system audio and webcam, with basic trimming and noise reduction. Its step capture feature records clicks and screenshots to generate a sequential guide, and smart redact helps hide sensitive information before sharing. Captures can be shared via a single click to Screencast hosting or other destinations.
notable: Single-click scrolling capture of entire web pages and spreadsheets
Step capture auto-generates sequential process guides from clicks
Smart redact to hide sensitive information
Team Themes apply consistent brand colors and fonts
caveats: Page indicates a team/business volume discount starting at five licenses, implying paid licensing; specific prices are not listed on this page
Most core features are available on both platforms, but the page does not detail every platform difference; full requirements are in a separate System Requirements article
Advanced video editing requires the separate Camtasia Editor product
